capabilities: : Jump to start or end of note
intentEvidence: Mixed Outline brings both into a single sidebar tree, so you can navigate the way you actually write.
motivation: Your ideas do not always fit inside headings.
problem: Standard outlines often fail to capture the structure present in numbered lists, forcing users to navigate in a way that does not match their writing style.
summary: A navigable outline that combines Markdown headings and numbered list items into a single, cohesive sidebar tree.
